'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Nick Reisch DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Reisch]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

Typed slang printout (not a handwritten Xerox form). Dark Restraining Bolt struck; handwritten No Escape.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
